correctness.rationale: Using last Poisson reset time A_t=min(E,t), X_t=2Λ∫_{t−A_t}^t B_s dW_s. Itô isometry gives E X_t²=4Λ² J_1(t), Wick integration yields E X_t⁴/t²→288Λ⁴/r² and Var(X_t²)/t²→272Λ⁴/r². Exact Markov conditional squared-moment closure with the unreset Ω_t gives the cross moment, so Corr(X_t²,X_{ct}²)→2/(17c) for fixed c>1; ordinary covariance has the factor e^(−r(c−1)t). For finitely many distinct positive macroscopic times, replacing Brownian B_s within each O(1) age window by B_{s_jT} has O(1/T) mean-square error after normalization, and disjoint Poisson windows give independent limiting ages/driving Gaussian factors. Laplace mixing yields product normal×Laplace and the density boundaries. Independent symbolic integration of the Wick polynomial confirmed the moment coefficients. Limit c=1 intentionally excluded.
